name: 世纪
group_note: "Zhanguo" (战国, Warring States) codebase, adm/obj/master.lpc lineage -- distinct from the sjecl/sje Century/adm-single family despite the similar slug. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.60-class master.lpc log_error()/standard_trace() -> CHANNEL_D mid-compile crash, guarded both with find_object(CHANNEL_D). (2) §7.8/§7.9 case-sensitive+absent counter files: logind.lpc's VISITORS/GIFTCARD macros pointed at /adm/single/MUDVISITOR and /adm/single/GIFTCARD (uppercase) while the on-disk files are lowercase mudvisitor/giftcard -- crashed sscanf() on EVERY connection ('the user is disconnected', empty-looking transcript). Fixed the macros to match on-disk case and added stringp() guards on both read_file() results as defense in depth. (3) A missing `return` in logind.lpc's logon(): the '!find_object(DNS_MASTER)' branch (always taken here, since dns_master is disabled from preload per the standing no-sockets policy) already shows a simplified banner and prompts for id, but without a return the function fell through and unconditionally called DNS_MASTER->query_muds() right after, triggering the classic undefined-socket-efun compile error on every single connection. (4) §7.56 duplicate security-daemon files: SECURITY_D resolves to adm/daemons/securd.lpc (a save-file/dbase-backed daemon with a hardcoded bootstrap admin, 'keyboy' as (zhuguan)), NOT the similarly-named adm/daemons/securityd.lpc which is an unused decoy file sharing no code path with the macro -- initially seeded a text-format /adm/etc/wizlist entry that had zero effect since securd.lpc doesn't read that file at all; corrected by adding a parallel set("wiz_status/fluffos","(admin)") line in securd.lpc's restore_list(), matching its own existing keyboy bootstrap pattern (AGENTS.md §1.5's hardcoded-bootstrap-admin-id class). Verified: full registration -> look/score/quit all clean, permission display shows 〖银河特警〗(Admin) correctly, matching securd.lpc's own wiz_rank() display strings. One non-blocking, already-out-of-preload issue left as noise (matches §7.6's 'exclude from preload, guard the callers' -- callers already correctly guarded with find_object() checks everywhere except the one logon() call site fixed above; a couple of secondary DNS_MASTER call sites elsewhere still log the same compile-error text harmlessly when reached, not chased further). LPC formatter run across all 2697 files; reverted 8 files with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption found via the same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 30 formatter-touched files; also checked all map.lpc-shaped files present -- none were ASCII-art zone maps, all clean cosmetic reformatting. Post-formatter re-verified clean.
